title: Naturality of the prescribed common-stage associator
statement: Fix a prime l, a scheme X with l invertible, and an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l. For the category C and tensor T of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], let a be the prescribed associator of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso]. For every three arrows f:K to Kprime, g:L to Lprime and h:M to Mprime, T(T(f,g),h) followed by a(Kprime,Lprime,Mprime) equals a(K,L,M) followed by T(f,T(g,h)). This concerns the chosen canonical associators, on all objects and all arrows.

proof.text: Restrict coherent reduction to the integral constructible category and use its faithfulness. The actual reduction/tensor comparison is natural by the naturality of the normalized tensor model and the reduction/limit counit. Apply that naturality twice to each nested tensor, and postcompose the integral square with the right nested comparison. The defining reduction equation for the prescribed integral associator and monoidal associator naturality identify the two sides. Cancel the comparison and use faithfulness.

Use the object and bilinear-morphism specification of rationalDerivedTensor and the localization formula for the rational associator. Induct on each of the three tensor-product Hom groups. Zero and sum cases follow from the specified linear maps and bilinearity of composition. On three pure tensors, both sides are the integral naturality equation tensored with the product of the three coefficients; associativity of coefficient multiplication identifies the scalar factors.

Choose representatives of the three arrows and then one finite stage above their stages and the stages of the four nested tensor objects. Apply the specified representative formula to the two inner tensor maps, and again to the outer tensor maps. Apply the specified representative formula for each common-stage associator. Composition at that same stage is composition of representatives. The outer inverse comparisons cancel; functoriality of rational tensor cancels the inner comparisons. Rational associator naturality proves equality of the resulting representatives, hence equality of their classes. No injectivity of scalar extension is used.

theorem commonStageTensorAssociator_naturality
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    {K K' L L' M M' : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X}
    (f : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L') (h : M ⟶ M') :
    let T := commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω X
    T.map (Prod.mkHom (T.map (Prod.mkHom f g)) h) ≫
        (pullbackTensorCommonAssociator l Ω X K' L' M').hom =
      (pullbackTensorCommonAssociator l Ω X K L M).hom ≫
        T.map (Prod.mkHom f (T.map (Prod.mkHom g h)))
